meta.name: lang_guard
meta.description: Language guard (073, plan N-angol, jav/devtools/lang_guard.py): a ratchet on the number of lines with Hungarian letters per tracked file. A file may not exceed its baseline entry; a file without an entry may not contain any. The baseline only shrinks (lang-guard --update); raising an entry needs lang-guard --accept <path> (document vocabulary, test data). allow: patterns that are never counted (UI translation files).
